Method of Attack: Once installed, the package runs a 'setup.py' file that establishes a reverse shell connection and deploys a Remote Access Trojan (RAT). The RAT has surveillance capabilities and can persist on the system. It can also be a Discord stealer.
Attack Vector: The package uses a popular French meme as its name to entice developers to download and install it.
Indicators of Compromise: Ngrok tunnel setup by package's author(s)
